notes.title: Update: Apparatus v1.25
notes.content:
1st off, I just want to say "Thank You" to anyone who has somehow stumbled upon this title and tried it out. I know It wasn't the best it could have been when I released it, and I apologize for that, but I genuinely believe it is in a much stronger place now and I aim to continue improving it.

So what's changed? Kind of a lot.
Most noticeably:
-[b]Lighting has been improved[/b]. Yes, this game takes place in a dark, run down factory, but that's no reason not to be able to see your surroundings. As such, more lights have been added/tweaked, dark shadowed areas have been lessened and an option has been added to the main menu to further increase brightness/gamma.  

-[b]When using a controller[/b], Playstation glyphs can now be displayed instead of xbox ones. You shall need to forgive this small indie developer, but I could not figure out a system to make the type of controller input recognized, so when using a controller you can now toggle whichsetup you wish to see in the pause/main menu.

-[b]Some new sfx/ music tracks have been added[/b]. You likely wont notice these, but still want to mention it. I am very finicky about the sounds that play in this game, and may alter them further in a future update.

-[b]Fixed a glitch[/b] where some enemy robots wouldn't respawn after killing player while simultaneously being destroyed. 

-[b]Small animation fixes to level intro "cutscenes"[/b] that just generally improve the game's look.

-[b]Minor level tweaks[/b] to try and make the factory feel more "alive"

That's all the noticeable stuff. As always, If you tried the game before (or picked it up on a whim during a sale) PLEASE let my know what you think could be improved for future updates. 

 Keep rolling.
-Scyclic Games

notes.title: Project Apparatus Update no.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889476/82ffde9a804e6e7385253bd8b8208fcde304961e.png[/img]


Greetings. This isn't a large update by any means, but I feel it is a much needed one. Hopefully these alterations are all for the better of making this game feel more complete.

First and foremost: Jumping has been "fixed"
-Due to some much needed player feedback, of which I am grateful for, I have given the player both a double jump, and removed the charge mechanic that allowed the player apparatus to jump higher (kind of).
To summarize:
-The stamina/jump bar now reflects the player's Nitrous levels. Use Nitrous to dash and double jump. 
-Pickup items have been added to support this mechanic.
-Holding the jump button for approximately a half second, immediately causes character to jump slightly higher than it would had the user simply tapped it.

-The player HUD now indicated whenever an item in proximity can be interacted with.
-HUD has also been reduced slightly, as I felt it didn't need to be as prominent as it was. However, this could change again if necessary.

-Minor visual changes and level fixes. This mainly includes general cleaning up of geometry, and altering any assets I believed would make the levels "flow" better.

-Some player SFXs have been either changed, fixed, or removed entirely.

-Finally, The tutorial text has been reformatted to just generally look/read better. Hopefully, this will help actually explain what players need to do in a concise manner.

I think that's all the important stuff. As always, do not hesitate to leave feedback, positive OR negative.  And more importantly, thank you for playing.

notes.title: Project Apparatus Update no. 3
notes.content:
Greetings! Some stuff has been added, and other stuff has been changed in order to improve sections of the game.

General Fixes:
-One of the biggest complaints, lack of air control, has been increased. The player now has slightly more maneuverability while jumping. This should make jumping onto a crate (for example) from a standstill position easier. However, momentum is still recommended for longer jumps.

-Inventory overhaul; yes, this game has an inventory menu. Why? BECAUSE.
It now has been modified in order to hold the max number of items, and make item descriptions readable. 

-Camera adjustments and player weapon swap tweaks.

-SFX changes and fixed volume slider not effecting certain sounds.

-Finally, there is now a fun little event located in level 3 for those willing to scavenge. 

As for the level specific fixes:

Level 2
-Turret firing has been adjusted to allow for more time between shots
-2 sections have been heavily reworked, and improved, to keep player from getting stuck in a specific area when transitioning planes.
- Altered geometry (mostly visual changes that do not affect gameplay)

Level 3
-On NG+, player can now access previously locked room
-minor changes to level geometry

Level 4
-Added invisible walls to impede player movement and prevent Apparatus from getting stuck in unintended areas.
-The entire main ending, basically.

That's all!
As always, please don't hesitate to leave feedback on how you believe the game could be improved so that I can make this project as good as it can be. Also, thank you for playing.

-Scyclic Games

notes.title: Project Apparatus update no.2
notes.content:
Greetings. Just a quick update because a few issues were brought to my attention, and I can't help myself from going back and adding/altering other stuff I think will make this game better.
Now, for the important stuff:

Non-lvl specific edits/fixes

-NG+ has been fully implemented
 --Energy does not recharge
 --NEW WEAPONS?!
 --slight alterations to story and enemies during sequential playthroughs.

-Improved weapon swap functionality (see NG+), and fixed a glitch where player could swap weapons when the apparatus was considered inactive

-Fixed an issue where dashing would cause the wheels to spin rabidly long after the action was performed. 

-The player's Apparatus can now be sliced in half vertically by spinning blades.
--Honestly meant to have this in sooner, but I kind of forgot.... my bad.

Level 3 edits

-Added general background assets to visually improve sections

-Revamped/edited cutscenes
-because I thought they looked cooler this way (opinions may vary)

-Minor changes to the main boss fight (If you know, you know)
--Saw blades are now SLIGHLTY easier to dodge (Original difficulty level moved to 2nd playthrough)
[If you managed to pass this section before now, CONGRATS! Seriously. I'm the developer and I sometimes had trouble consistently clearing it]

Level 4 edits

-Fixed a bug where ending text wouldn't play unless certain criteria were met.

-general Lighting/geometry fixes that I'm sure no one will notice

-Added optional dialogue 

Level 5 edits (yes, there is a 5th level)

-Altered enemy placements
-Fixed an issue where Apparatus's wheels would not turn when moving on the x-axis
-other fun stuff

Apologies, a few additional things that I missed worth mentioning

-added energy dispenser for NG+ on level 3
[Ensures that should the player run out of energy, they can still backtrack and get more, where as the previous build required a level restart]

-The last weapon parts can now be picked up in either order
[Changed from one not showing up in player inventory until the 1st was obtained]

-Level 4 select menu button has been fixed, and will now function correctly after the player has completed level 5
{Just on the off chance anyone wants to go back after finishing the game]

-Finally, fixed player not being able to shoot until a prior action was performed in level 5
[required adjusting both start and end cutscenes, but I think this worked out for the better]

OKAY. Now that's everything. If you have found something you think I should address in the next patch, let me know. I intend to make this game as good as it can be (within my skillset, of course). 

Thanks for playing!
